title: Interim SLO coverage matrix and on-call gap scan (Sep 2027)
content:
Purpose:
A lightweight, ad-hoc matrix to map critical endpoints to temporary SLO cover tactics for the upcoming week of 2027-09-15 -> 2027-09-21. Designed for fast cross-team handoffs: who owns the temporary fallback, expected cost delta if activated, on-call contact, and degradations to communicate to customers. Use this to make ~24–72h decisions while longer mitigations are scheduled.

Table (rows are endpoints / product routes):
| Endpoint | Primary SLO | Temporary fallback | Owner (team) | On-call (contact) | Est. cost delta / hr | Customer impact notes | Action by (date) |
| /v1/generate | p95 latency < 300ms | route -> gpt-lv-small | serving-runtime | arjun.patel@redwood.com | +$4.50 | increased response variance, possible shorter completions | 2027-09-13 |
| /v1/embeddings | 99.95% success | queue-to-batch + retry | infra | lucia.gomez@redwood.com | +$1.20 | slight delay (200-400ms) on spikes | 2027-09-14 |
| /v1/chat/stream | p90 latency < 250ms | degrade to chunked streaming | console-and-tooling | samir.rao@redwood.com | +$2.75 | multi-chunk reads, UI needs spinner | 2027-09-14 |
| dedicated-provisioning | end-to-end < 60s | limit to core tiers only | platform-engineering | priya.menon@redwood.com | +$0.00 | some customers see provisioning queue | 2027-09-15 |

Quick read / interpretation:
- /v1/generate is the highest immediate cost risk but also highest user-visible latency. Short-term fallback to gpt-lv-small decreases tail CPU/GPU pressure; expect lower token fidelity.
- Embeddings backlog can be mitigated by batching; cost per token goes down but user latency increases. Batching policy needs a temporary exception for 15m windows.
- Streaming chat should prefer chunked streaming to preserve service availability; front-end needs a quick feature flag to allow spinner + partial renders.
- Dedicated provisioning restrictions are a non-cost mitigation (throttling new capacity) and should be communicated to sales/CS.

Open risks and constraints:
- Fallback model variants require model caching/priming which is currently gated by infra quota (ENG-4821). If cache misses spike, fallback cost could double.
- Customer-facing messaging templates are not finalized; recommend a single short banner copy and a status page snippet. See conf:1203 for language.
- On-call rotation has a weekend gap (Sat 09/18) for platform-engineering; consider temporary cross-cover from infra.

Immediate action list (owner -> action -> due):
- Arjun (serving-runtime) -> deploy route override to gpt-lv-small; add telemetry tag 'temp-fallback' -> 2027-09-13 EOD
- Lucia (infra) -> enable batching window for embeddings for 15m test slot; collect token-cost delta -> 2027-09-14 11:00 PT
- Samir (console) -> flip UI flag for partial streaming + spinner; release behind feature flag -> 2027-09-14 15:00 PT
- Priya (platform) -> publish temporary provisioning note to sales + CS; add dispatcher rule to limit new provisionings -> 2027-09-15

Communication plan (short):
- Status page: one-line banner noting 'temporary performance mitigation in effect, limited to select routes' + link to support/FAQ. Owner: product-ops -> Maya Chen.
- Sales/CS: Slack briefing + 1 pager (use conf:1203 template). Owner: Priya.

Follow-up metrics to report 24h after mitigations:
- p95 and p99 latency per endpoint (compare to baseline)
- Token spend delta per hour and projected weekly delta
- Error rate change and user-visible degradations logged

Parking-lot / questions for next sync:
- If the fallback holds for >72h, who signs off on extended use and who owns customer refunds? (pointer: finance-runbook)
- Is there an automated rollback condition we want to add (e.g., cost > $X/hr)?

Notes to self (scratch):
- Keep this sheet tight — move long-form decisions to Confluence page linked above.
- Add entry rows if regional fallbacks (EU/APAC) are needed; current entries assume US region.

Last quick status update (2027-09-14 09:05 PT):
- Arjun: route override staged, awaiting infra cache bump
- Lucia: batching test scheduled for 09:30 PT
- Samir: UI flag merged to canary, monitoring for regressions
- Priya: sales note drafted, awaiting sign-off

If you are listed as on-call above and cannot cover, ping Maya Chen in #ops-rapid with availability window and suggested cross-cover.
